These records contradict the categorical premise that developers have no real means of limiting activity. They do not establish perfect enforcement or disprove occasional bypasses. The architectural explanation remains tentative, as Zitron presented it.
limitations: The result depends on reading no real way as a categorical inability, rather than an allegation of occasional enforcement failures.
The subscription observation is a single user report.
